title: PolicyIssuanceFailed v1 - data
description: The insurer did not issue after payment: it declined (failureKind INSURER_DECLINED) or issuance could not complete (ISSUANCE_ERROR, TAT_EXHAUSTED). The single post-payment non-issuance event: it supersedes ProposalDeclined (catalogue section 2.1). Journey compensates; payment starts the refund when refundRequired. Producer: policy. Status: CONTRACTED. The `data` member of event-envelope/v1 (ADR-025): ids and states only, never customer PII.

failureKind.description: Why no policy was issued (additive; absent = ISSUANCE_ERROR)

applicationNumber.description: Insurer application number (insurer-issued reference, not customer data)

refundRequired.description: true when captured funds must be returned (payment.refund consumer)
